name: Citizenship by Marriage (Registration)

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a Jamaican citizen, per Section 5A of the Jamaican Nationality Act.

sources.title: Jamaica Information Service (JIS) -- Citizenship by Marriage: registration under Section 5A of the Jamaican Nationality Act for a person married to a Jamaican citizen, fee JMD 15,000 / USD 260, ~1 year processing

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Jamaica). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 JIS sourced. Gender-neutral on its face (Section 5A applies to spouses of Jamaican citizens generally) -- unlike jm_family_reunification.json's Marriage Exemption Certificate, no asymmetry by the applicant's sex was found in the sourcing for this citizenship-registration route specifically; the two should not be conflated. This route grants citizenship itself, distinct from the Marriage Exemption Certificate (jm_family_reunification.json), which only exempts a foreign spouse from needing a standard work permit and does not itself confer citizenship or PR.
